Lists all Montgomery census tracts with zero listed pharmacies by left-joining every tract to the pre-aggregated pharmacy count and keeping tracts where the count is null or zero.
sql:
WITH tract_pharmacy AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         n AS pharmacy_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_2e611c'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(p.pharmacy_count, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN tract_pharmacy p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(p.pharmacy_count, 0) = 0
ORDER BY pharmacy_count ASC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
